title: Guide Mesh · desacoplar override humano explícito del transporte Supabase
mission: Reconciliá el gate legado de mutaciones del Guide Mesh con la autoridad humana explícita del /wc actual. Cuando el HUMAN MESSAGE autoriza de forma explícita el trabajo reversible acotado y el worker ya posee un Guide role PIN válido, esa excepción durable no debe depender de que Supabase pueda crear un Work Trace. Sin esa autoridad humana explícita, el gate de coordinator approval sigue intacto. Una denegación explícita de connector/safety sigue siendo terminal y jamás puede reinterpretarse como override. Implementá el mínimo cambio reutilizando los owners actuales; no crees un nuevo broker, scheduler, store de autoridad ni familia de workers.
definition_of_done: Existe una regla durable y machine-checkable que distingue explicit human /wc authority + valid Guide role PIN de la ruta ordinaria de coordinator approval.
Con explicit human authority válida, la ruta bounded/reversible poseída no depende de Supabase Work Trace transport.
Sin explicit human authority, GUIDE_MESH_GOVERNANCE_V1 sigue requiriendo coordinator approval para mutaciones materiales.
Una explicit connector/safety denial sigue siendo terminal y no puede ser desviada ni bypassed.
El override no amplía claim scope, generation fencing, promotion, destructive, privacy ni credential authority.
Tests deterministas cubren authorized, unauthorized, explicit-denial y scope-boundary cases.
No se crea arquitectura paralela ni se modifica CURRENT/Human Accepted/Served.
allowed_scope: coordination/guide/** authority/helper test files directly required by this repair
coordination/workers/** authority contract/test files directly required by this repair
wc only if compatibility wording must be aligned with the executable contract

semantic_identity.problem: legacy guide mesh material-mutation gate requires supabase work trace transport even when the human /wc launch explicitly authorizes the bounded reversible role and a central role pin is already held
acceptance: deterministic regression covers authorized unauthorized and explicit-denial cases
explicit connector or safety denial remains terminal and cannot be bypassed by the override path
override cannot expand claim scope promotion authority destructive authority privacy access or credential access
with explicit human /wc authorization plus a valid claimed guide role pin a durable override path does not depend on supabase work trace transport for that bounded owned scope
without explicit human authorization the existing coordinator approval gate remains required

truth_boundary: Candidate control-plane repair only. The semantic pin and derived job grant no execution, promotion, destructive, privacy or credential authority; ordinary portfolio PIN/claim remains required.
